changelog: `apm install --dry-run plugin@marketplace` no longer writes the marketplace ref-pin file under APM_HOME (#4217)

ledger_row.summary: The marketplace resolver recorded the plugin ref in APM_HOME cache/marketplace/version-pins.json on every resolution, so install --dry-run (and read-only apm view) wrote user-scope state.

red: APM_E2E_TESTS=1 APM_BINARY_PATH="$(uv run which apm)" uv run --extra dev pytest tests/integration/test_marketplace_ref_pin_lifecycle.py -n 0 -p no:cacheprovider -q -> FAILED test_install_dry_run_of_marketplace_plugin_writes_no_ref_pin: `assert not world.pins.exists()` (assert not True; .../home/.apm/cache/marketplace/version-pins.json)
green: APM_E2E_TESTS=1 APM_BINARY_PATH="$(uv run which apm)" uv run --extra dev pytest tests/integration/test_marketplace_ref_pin_lifecycle.py -n 0 -p no:cacheprovider -q -> 2 passed
notes: One owner-level fix for #4212 and #4194: resolver.py now only stages the pin (stage_ref_pin); InstallTransaction opens one RefPinStage per attempt, writes it in commit() and discards it on rollback and dry-run completion. Commands with no install transaction (apm view, uninstall registry fallback) now check pins but never write them. Ref-swap warning behaviour is unchanged. The real install in the same test asserts the pin is still recorded (positive control).
